title: Small influences and Condorcet rationality
statement: For every $\eta>0$, there is a $\tau>0$ such that, for every natural number $n$ and every function $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ taking only the values $-1$ and $1$, if its largest absolute coordinate influence is at most $\tau$, then the fraction of profiles assigning each of $n$ voters one of the six strict rankings of three alternatives for which the three pairwise social outputs are not all equal is at most $\frac34+\frac{3}{2\pi}\arcsin(\frac13)+\eta$.
